validity.recommendation: Reclassify as the Shedgum–Yanbu NGL line (carries natural gas liquids/ethane, not dry sales gas); fix the conflated length/diameter (see spec finding). The Eastern-Province→Yanbu cross-kingdom 'gas' line is an NGL pipeline, not a dry-gas transmission trunk.
validity.researcher_notes: P3962 is recorded as Fuel=Gas, PipelineType=transmission, but every independent source for a cross-kingdom Eastern-Province→Yanbu line in the gas family describes a Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) line, not a dry sales-gas transmission trunk. Techint (constructor's own retrospective, 2023) calls it the 'Shedgum-Yanbu gas pipeline' begun ~1978 (45-yr retrospective) running from the Shedgum separation/processing plant to the Yanbu fractionation plant; the wider record (Aramco Master Gas System materials, Saudipedia) is explicit that the 1978 Shedgum→Yanbu line transports NGL and ethane (~1,170 km) for cracking at Yanbu — i.e. NGL feedstock, not dry methane transmission. Argaam (2017) describes the SHY-1 expansion as an NGL pipeline (585 km, 30"). So the entity is real but the commodity/type is most accurately NGL, not generic 'Gas'. The current ref stack also points at NGL/oil sources (al-madina title literally reads 'oil project linking east of the kingdom to its west'). Existence itself is not in doubt — independently corroborated — hence classification, not existence.

validity.researcher_notes: Roster shows P3966 carries the EXACT same name as P3962 ('East–West Gas Pipeline (Saudi Arabia)') with the same Abqaiq→Yanbu endpoints but different specs (len=821, cap=5.20, dia blank) — a classic relabel/segment double-count. Separately, GEM already maintains distinct wiki pages for the crude Petroline ('East-West Crude Oil Pipeline') and the NGL line ('Abqaiq-Yanbu NGL pipeline' — the Shedgum-Yanbu_Gas_Pipeline title redirects there), so the same Eastern-Province→Yanbu corridor risks being tracked three ways. P3962 should be merged with / disambiguated from P3966 and cross-checked against those two pages.

validity.recommendation: Correct length/diameter: 1200 km + 48" are the CRUDE Petroline (East-West Crude Oil Pipeline) specs, not the gas/NGL line's. The NGL Shedgum→Yanbu line is ~1,166–1,170 km; the major expansion loop is 585 km × 30". Verify which physical line P3962 is meant to represent before fixing the numbers.
validity.researcher_notes: GEM stores len=1200 km, dia=48". Independent sources show 1,200 km + 48"(/56") = the Petroline / East-West CRUDE OIL pipeline (built 1981, ~5 Mbbl/d crude): offshore-technology lists the Abqaiq–Yanbu oil line at 1,204 km, max 48", crude, started 1981, operated by Saudi Aramco; European Business Magazine and ENR corroborate 1,200 km / 48"+56" / 1981 / crude. By contrast the gas-family (NGL) line is ~1,166–1,170 km (techint: '1,166 kilometres'; Master Gas System materials: ~1,170 km) and its 2007/2014 expansion loop (SHY-1) is 585 km × 30" (argaam). So 1200/48 has been imported from the crude line onto this 'gas' row — independent sources materially disagree with the GEM number for a gas/NGL line. StartYear=1978 matches the NGL line's start, not the crude line (1981) — further evidence the row mixes two pipelines.
